visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A thick piece of duck breast with red skin is being seared in a black frying pan, with hot oil bubbling and white steam rising against a dark, industrial kitchen background. (2) Slices of cooked duck meat are carefully placed over a bed of dark purple rice in a light-colored cardboard meal box using metal tongs. (3) Two white ceramic bowls containing healthy meals with sliced meats, greens, and eggs are displayed on a dark wooden table with warm indoor lighting. (4) A close-up reveals a slice of duck meat topped with a clove of garlic, held by wooden chopsticks to highlight the juicy pink interior and crispy skin. (5) A clear plastic spoon holds a half-cut soft-boiled egg with a vibrant orange liquid yolk over a box of seasonal vegetables. (6) Chopsticks pick up a piece of yellow sweet potato and then stir through the purple rice grains in a meal box. (7) A glistening, honey-glazed chicken leg is sliced and a piece is lifted with chopsticks, showing the steam and sauce. (8) A bowl of chicken leg topped with fresh chopped green scallions and chili is presented to the camera. (9) A piece of grilled mackerel with a charred skin and sesame seed garnish is held up by chopsticks over a meal box. (10) A white plastic container of mini hot pot is shown, filled with pork slices, corn, baby corn, mushrooms, and leafy greens in a clear broth. (11) A clear spoon scoops the transparent hot pot broth, followed by chopsticks lifting thin, tender pork slices from the steaming soup. (12) The chopsticks stir through tofu and other vegetables inside the hot pot container. (13) A small separate white bowl filled with purple rice is shown next to the hot pot. (14) The meal box and hot pot are shown packed inside a clear plastic carrier bag with a red logo. (15) A staff member wearing a tan uniform, a black face mask, and a cap is seen working behind a wooden counter in a warmly lit shop with brick walls. (16) The restaurant's exterior is showcased, featuring a red brick facade, large arched glass windows, and a dark wooden door with a brass handle.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional review to showcase the diverse and healthy menu options at '健人餐廚' (Jianren Kitchen), highlighting both their signature meal boxes (duck, chicken, fish) and their individual mini hot pots. It appeals to health-conscious diners through vibrant food presentation and clear contact information for ordering.
